releases.name: v0.1.0 — First public release
releases.body:
First public release of **opencode-subagent-studio** — manage OpenCode V2 subagents from the OpenCode Desktop settings.

## Highlights

- Settings page for user-level and project-level subagent scopes: search, hidden/disabled badges, built-in \`general\` / \`explore\` model overrides
- Editor with model + reasoning-effort picker, three-state permission matrix (allow / ask / deny), colour presets, max steps and hidden flag
- Whole-file V1 → V2 migration with a side-by-side preview — comments, key order and unknown fields are preserved
- Live sync for user-level agent directories; save-conflict detection (reload / overwrite with backup) and atomic writes
- Interface in 11 languages (en, zh, fr, es, br, ru, ar, de, ja, hi, ko); 290 unit tests; MIT licensed

## Install

Published on npm — add the package name to \`plugins\` in \`opencode.jsonc\` and fully restart the desktop app:

\`\`\`jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-subagent-studio"]
}
\`\`\`

Or install from source: clone the repo into \`~/.config/opencode/plugins/\`, run \`npm install && npm run build\`, and point \`plugins\` at the directory. See the [README](https://github.com/VicChenBike/opencode-subagent-studio#readme) for full instructions.

## Compatibility

Built against OpenCode Desktop 2.2.5; verified compatible with 2.2.6. The host plugin API is experimental upstream, so newer desktop releases may require a plugin update.
